title: The Plan
text:
*The plan is simple: get to the Duke, stop the poison, and wake the old lion before the city falls. Thomas will get you inside. The rest is up to you.*

*Thomas meets you at the servant's entrance, pale with fear but resolute. He leads you through back corridors to the Duke's chambers. The new physician — Goran's man — sits in the anteroom, reading.*

*The wine on the Duke's table is laced — you can smell the faint sweetness of nightbloom beneath the grape. The physician looks up as you enter.*

Physician: "Who are you? You can't be here! Guards!"

choices.text: Restrain the physician before he can call for help
Reveal the poison — make him confess in front of witnesses
Let Thomas distract him while you swap the poisoned wine
